name: xp
description: Issue-driven XP workflow: GitHub Issues as planner, refinement, TDD, bugfix, ship and retro with requirements traceability.

interface.shortDescription: Issue-driven dev loop with TDD and traceability
interface.longDescription: Sets up a project for an issue-driven workflow (labels, Definition of Ready/Done, YAML requirements) and guides the agent through triage, refinement, test-driven implementation, bugfixing, shipping and retrospectives.
